places.now: Imperial War Museum London, in the surviving central block of the 1815 Bethlem building on Lambeth Road
places.reason: In Dickens's time (from 1815 until the move to Beckenham in 1930) Bethlem stood in St George's Fields, Southwark; the gazetteer's guess is the same building, which later became the IWM.
Scrooge's boyhood school is an unnamed fictional building in the countryside, generally linked to Dickens's own school days, with no specific location.
